positions.title: SRC President
positions.description: Head of the Student Representative Council and chief student liaison to school leadership.
Assists the President, leads student committee projects, and presides in the President’s absence.
positions.title: Vice President
General Secretary
positions.description: Maintains official meeting records, coordinates agendas, and manages student council communications.
Oversees student activity funds, club budgets, and publishes transparent financial reports.
positions.title: Treasurer
Public Relations Officer (P.R.O.)
positions.description: Manages announcements, bulletin boards, social campaigns, and school spirit initiatives.

candidates.name: Maya Lin
candidates.slogan: Action, Accountability, and All Voices Heard.
candidates.manifesto: As your SRC President, I will advocate for improved study hall spaces, transparent communication between students and administration, and an open forum every month where any student can submit ideas directly to the council.
My goal is to expand student club funding, revitalize inter-class sports tournaments, and partner with the cafeteria to introduce healthier, student-voted snack options throughout the semester.
candidates.name: Marcus Adebayo
candidates.slogan: Uniting Our Campus for a Stronger Future.

candidates.manifesto: I plan to launch a peer mentorship program connecting incoming junior students with senior study buddies, and organize school-wide wellness weeks during midterms.
candidates.slogan: Dedicated to Teamwork and Inclusive Programs.
candidates.name: Elena Rostova

candidates.manifesto: I will establish a streamlined digital suggestion box, ensure school lockers and equipment are promptly serviced, and support student-led community outreach drives.
candidates.slogan: Practical Solutions for Real Student Needs.
candidates.name: Tariq Hassan
Chloe Bennett
candidates.manifesto: Minutes will be published within 24 hours of every SRC meeting on our school notice board. Every student will always know what decisions are being made on their behalf.

candidates.name: Daniel Chen
candidates.manifesto: I will build a shared digital newsletter and calendar so no student ever misses a club signup, spirit day theme, or leadership deadline.

candidates.slogan: Every Cent Accounted For, Every Club Supported.
candidates.name: Sofia Al-Mansoor
candidates.manifesto: I bring two years of club bookkeeping experience. I will ensure fair and equitable budget allocations across arts, STEM, athletics, and cultural societies.

candidates.name: Liam O’Connor
candidates.manifesto: I pledge to publish quarterly visual budget graphs so the entire student body can see exactly how council dues and fundraiser proceeds are utilized.

candidates.name: Amara Okafor
candidates.manifesto: From high-energy pep rallies to vibrant graphic flyers for campus events, I will make sure our school spirit is higher than ever before!

candidates.name: Lucas Vance
candidates.slogan: Your Stories, Your Voice, Front and Center.
candidates.manifesto: I will highlight student achievements, showcase classroom projects, and run student spotlight interviews on the main hallway video displays.
